description: Scripted phrase set for the voice bench (issue #34) and the voice E2E test (#37). Each phrase is something a user says to the Nexus shell; reply is a fixed answer so TTS cost is comparable across backends.

phrases.text: set a timer for ten minutes
what is on my calendar this afternoon
phrases.reply: You have two meetings this afternoon, at two and at four.

phrases.text: search the web for the weather in Edmonton
phrases.reply: Searching the web for the weather in Edmonton.

phrases.text: summarize the article I have open in the browser
phrases.reply: Here is a short summary of the article. It covers three main points, and I have put them in the notes panel for you.
